en: Now it's time to practice what you learned.
And I'll be honest, this will now be quite a
challenging task.
I want you to write a new script with these
core APIs
where the user is prompted to enter
an internet address, let's say google.com,
whatever.
And the script should then send a request, a
network request, to that address,
fetch all the content it can get from there,
and store that content in a text file.
Now for that, you will need to know how to
send network requests. You can use the Fetch
API for that, which you probably know from
the browser. If you never worked with it,
you'll not be able to send that request. In
that case, just store the user input in a
file. But as a bonus, try using that input,
which should be a URL, to send a request and
store the response data. For example, the
HTML code that is being returned in a file.
That is your task here.
Definitely challenging. Try it on your own.
We'll of course then also solve it together
thereafter.
